description: Tanker Water Supply by Station is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset details the distribution of water supplied by tankers across various stations in Qatar. It categorizes the water supply according to different sectors, including KAHRAMAA-rented tankers, municipal, education, defense, police, other government entities, rural tankers, and private transport. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water, Distribution, tankers. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
